spanish: No oprimirás a tu prójimo, y no robarás; no pernoctará salario de jornalero contigo hasta mañana.

findings.issue: בֹּקֶר is the noun morning; «hasta mañana» states tomorrow and drops morning.
שָׂכִיר is the adjective hired (hireling by the day or the year); «jornalero» narrows it to a day-laborer.

notes: Person, number, and qal force match; «salario» stays inside the wages sense of פְּעֻלָּה.
